entries.Original:
Add an alarm.
---------- Time-based ----------
+ Trigger at a specific time.
+ Can only be created in Alarm window.
---------- Weather-based ----------
+ Trigger ONCE at a specific weather at a specific time, or REPEAT every time the weather occurs.
+ Can be created in Alarm window, or clicking on Weather bar.
---------- FATE-based ----------
 + Trigger every time a specific FATE occurs (CE Alarm only triggered when Resistance Recruitment in-game window is open).
+ Can be created in Alarm window, or click on Alarm column in Fate/CE table.
------------------------------
+ Alarm can be turned off, edited, deleted, or recycled once expire.
entries.Translated:
添加 alarm。
------基于时间的 ------
+ 在特定时间触发。
+ 只能在闹钟窗口中创建。
————基于天气的————————
+ 在特定天气、特定时间触发一次，或在每次天气发生时重复触发。
+ 可以在闹钟窗口中创建，也可以点击天气栏。
基于 FATE 的
+ 每次发生特定 FATE 时触发 (CE 警报仅在游戏内抵抗力招募窗口打开时触发)
+ 可以在警报窗口中创建，也可以单击命运/CE 表中的警报列。
---------------------
+ 警报一旦过期，可以关闭、编辑、删除或回收。

entries.Original:
- The difficulty is only at around EX, mechanic wise.
- Community runs happen quite often and are super friendly, newbies and vets alike.
entries.Translated:
从机械角度来看，困难仅在于 EX 附近。
社区跑步经常发生，而且非常友好，新手和老手都是如此。

entries.Original: But I'll have to grind for stuff to run, right?
entries.Translated: 但是我得努力工作才能有东西跑，对吧？

entries.Original: - Yes, generally it goes like this:
entries.Translated: 是的，通常情况下是这样的：

entries.Original: 1. You register for a role of your choice.
entries.Translated: 1. 你注册一个你选择的角色。

entries.Original: 2. You check what stuff are required for your role (Reraiser, Essence & Actions)
entries.Translated: 2. 你检查一下你的角色需要哪些素材 (Reraiser, Essence & Actions)

entries.Original:
+ Reraisers => sprite farming (super easy).
+ Essence   => cluster farming (moderately easy).
+ Actions     => cluster farming.
							Or a specific mob farming.
							Or marketboard.
You can use this plugin to find which actions drop from which fragments and their sources, and proceed from there.
entries.Translated:
+ Reraisers => 精灵养殖 (超级简单)。
+ Essence => 集群养殖 (相对容易)
+ 行动=>集群养殖。
或者是一种特定的群体耕作方式。
或者市场委员会。
你可以使用这个插件来查找哪些操作会从哪些片段及其来源中掉落，然后从那里继续。

entries.Original: - Three hours of farming are prob sufficient for 3-5 runs. A clear is usually before 15 runs.
entries.Translated: 3 小时的耕作时间大概足以完成 3-5 次跑步。通常在 15 次跑步之前会有一次清理。

entries.Original: This is overwhelming. Where do I even start?
entries.Translated: 这简直令人难以置信。我该从哪里开始呢？

entries.Original: - First step of getting into DRS is to
entries.Translated: 进入 DRS 的第一步是

entries.Original: join a community and seek advice.

Wikis and plugins can only get you so far. The resources and supports provided by DRS communities will get you to the end and beyond.

For that reason, this plugin will not try to teach you how to do DRS, but rather pointers to the resources and communities that excel in such task.
entries.Translated:
维基百科和插件只能帮助你到此为止。DRS 社区提供的资源和支持将带你走到尽头，甚至更远。

因此，这个插件不会试图教你如何使用 DRS，而是会指出在这项任务中表现出色的资源和社区。

entries.Original: - Requirements are relatively clear-cut. Most DRS hosts only ask participants to:
entries.Translated: - 要求相对明确。大多数 DRS 主机只要求参与者：

entries.Original: • Respect their guidelines.	• Bring appropriate actions.	• No toxic and have fun.
entries.Translated: 遵守他们的指导方针。采取适当的行动。无毒，玩得开心。

entries.Original: - No parse, no hardcore raiding experience required.
entries.Translated: 不需要 Parse，不需要硬核突袭经验。

entries.Original: - Don't hesitate to DC travel between communities. Just make sure to stick with your static til the end, even if you've already cleared in another group!
entries.Translated: - 不要犹豫在社区之间穿梭。只要确保坚持你的静态直到最后，即使你已经在另一个群体中通关了！

entries.Original: Out of respect, we ask our users to AVOID mentioning this plugin in any community.
entries.Translated: 出于尊重，我们请求我们的用户在任何社区中提及这个插件。

entries.Original:
First off, plugins are against ToS. Hence don't talk about it in the first place.
- Info in this plugin should be taken with a grain of salt.
- We don't want people to annoy the mods/hosts by bringing this plugin up as an argument or excuse (i.e. '...but Bozja Buddy made me bring wrong stuff').
- We created this plugin to makes life easier, not to become a nuisance to anyone.
entries.Translated:
首先，插件是反 ToS 的。所以一开始就不要谈论它。
这个插件中的信息应该谨慎对待。
我们不希望人们以这个插件作为论据或借口来惹恼 mods/host(即 “......但是 Bozja Buddy 让我带错了东西”)。
我们创建这个插件是为了让生活更轻松，而不是成为任何人的负担。

entries.Original: - This plugin is not affiliated with any community or website. All content included in this plugin is NOT created/owned by the dev; they are community-effort.
entries.Translated: 本插件与任何社区或网站无关。本插件中包含的所有内容均非开发者创建/拥有;它们是社区努力的结果。

entries.Original: - Typically, there are three types of run: Static, Anyprog, and Reclear.
entries.Translated: 通常有三种运行类型:Static、Anyprog 和 Reclear。

- Reclears may also accept TA enrage/Queen's prog, depends on host. Please make sure to check with the host.

Reclears 也可能接受 TA enrage/Queen’s prog，具体取决于主机。请务必与主机确认。

entries.Original:
For safety reason, this plugin does not automatically update your Field note progress. As such, manual instruction is as follow:
1. Open the Collection window, using text command "/collection".
2. Choose "Field Record".
3. At the bottom the Field Record in-game window are page numbers. Go through each page, and the plugin will get the data from there.

- You can also add/remove a Field note from your progress by [Shift+LMB] on a field note's icon.
entries.Translated:
出于安全考虑，这个插件不会自动更新您的 Field Note 进度。因此，手动说明如下：
1.使用文本命令 “/collection” 打开 Collection 窗口。
2. 选择 “现场记录”。
3. 在游戏中的 “现场记录” 窗口底部显示页码。浏览每个页面，插件将从中获取数据。

您还可以通过 [Shift+LMB] 在字段笔记的图标上添加/移除字段笔记。

entries.Original:
Keybinds basic
[LMB]                           Select/Drag nodes by the handle.
[RMB]                           Extra options on the handle.
[MiddleClick]              Delete a canvas by the handle.
[MouseScroll]             Zoom in/out on canvas.
[Crtl + LMB]                Multi-selecting nodes.
[Shift + LMB drag]     Multi-selecting nodes within an area.
[Ctrl + C]                      Copy selected nodes to clipboard.
[Ctrl + V]                      Paste selected nodes to active canvas.

Basics
- Nodes can be added, deleted, edited, minimnized, and resized.
- Nodes can be bundled and moved around, using its plug on top-left corner and LMB.
- Nodes can be connected to each other, using its plug on top-left corner and LMB.
- Nodes' connections can be modified in pre-defined path for organizing's sake, using a button in the middle of the connection's line.

Saving and Auto-save
- Viewer and all of its canvasses' data can be saved manually.
- It can also be auto-saved, every X seconds (configurable in config).
- Auto-save only runs when the viewer is visible.
- Any adjustments that are not saved will be lost.
entries.Translated:
基本键绑定
[LMB] 使用手柄选择/拖动节点。
[RMB] 手柄上的额外选项。
[MiddleClick] 按手柄删除画布。
[MouseScroll] 放大/缩小画布。
[Crtl + LMB] 多选节点。
[Shift + LMB drag] 在区域内多选节点。
[Ctrl + C] 将选定的节点复制到剪贴板。
[Ctrl + V] 将选定节点粘贴到活动画布。

基础知识
节点可以添加、删除、编辑、最小化和调整大小。
节点可以捆绑并移动，使用其左上角的插件和 LMB。
节点可以使用其左上角的插件和 LMB 相互连接。
出于组织目的，可以使用连接线中间的按钮，在预定义的路径中修改节点的连接。

保存和自动保存
可以手动保存查看器及其所有画布的数据。
它也可以每 X 秒自动保存一次 (可在 config 中配置)。
自动保存功能仅在查看器可见时运行。
任何未保存的调整都将丢失。
